messages:
eli-support: Customer reports promo credits being consumed before paid credits; customer sees paid invoice charges while dashboard shows promo balance still positive. They say credits expired yesterday but billing shows consumption from wrong bucket. account: REDACTED, sent in DM with example invoice and a few request IDs.
kevin-billing: got the account + ids. quick check: ledger shows two promo buckets with different expirations. will dig.
eli-support: customer urgent — their production calls began failing once credits hit zero. They provided 3 failing request ids.
julia_eng: looping in eng-billing. can you paste a sample request id and the invoice line we should look at?
matt: cc @sara-finance for any manual reversals, and @ops-bot for tracking.
eli-support: pasted request id `req_9a3f2b` and a snippet from invoice: `promo_credit: -50, paid_credit: -200, balance: 20` — customer asserts that promo should have been used first.
kevin-billing: quick note: our consumption algorithm historically used LIFO on promo buckets; there was a migration last quarter to a canonical ordering but iirc we intended to honor earliest-expiry-first. suspect the migration left an inconsistent comparator.
sara-finance: finance saw a handful of manual adjustments during the migration window (June 2025). we flagged potential ordering differences but didn't have repro.
julia_eng: on it. initial hypothesis: credit application comparator prioritized `start_ts` over `expiry_ts`. that would consume later-expiring promos prematurely.
eli-support: customer timeline: created promo 2025-08-10, another promo 2025-09-01 (expires earlier), used tokens 2025-10-15 onward. they expect the second promo (earlier expiry) to be consumed first.
kevin-billing: found ledger rows for `req_9a3f2b` — shows promo bucket id `pb_77` (start 09-01, expiry 10-01) left untouched while later promo `pb_64` (start 08-10, expiry 11-01) was consumed. that's the bug.
julia_eng: repro steps: 1) local replicate using ledger snapshot 2025-10-15, 2) run consumption engine v2.1, 3) compare applied bucket ids. failing comparator is `comparePromoBuckets(a,b) => a.start_ts < b.start_ts`. should be by expiry then start.
eli-support: can you paste a short repro snippet for our support ticket? customers like seeing concrete steps.
julia_eng: pasted code block:
```
// simplified comparator used in v2.1
function comparePromoBuckets(a, b) {
  return a.start_ts - b.start_ts; // WRONG: ignores expiry
}

// fix: compare by expiry then start
function comparePromoBucketsFixed(a, b) {
  if (a.expiry_ts !== b.expiry_ts) return a.expiry_ts - b.expiry_ts;
  return a.start_ts - b.start_ts;
}
```
kevin-billing: created incident and attached ledger diff.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2027 (priority: P2) assigned to eng-billing.
julia_eng: plan: patch comparator, run unit tests, run a staging backfill that simulates consumption on a 7-day window. if results look good, run controlled backfill for affected accounts (we found 3 orgs in quick scan).
sara-finance: approve one-off customer credit for discrepancy while we fix. log ref CF-9876. amount: 120 credits.
matt: request: estimate user impact and rollback plan. backfill should be idempotent; ensure ledger.lock prevents double-apply.
julia_eng: dry-run scheduled tonight 02:00 UTC on staging; backfill script ready in `eng-billing/tools/backfill_credit_order`. requires ~30m maintenance window for ledger lock enforcement. risk low for API availability.
kevin-billing: after dry-run we can reprocess the customer's consumption for the affected date range and adjust invoices if needed. I'll coordinate with finance for credits & invoice memo.
eli-support: told customer we applied a temporary credit and will confirm final balance after backfill. provided INC-2027 and CF-9876 refs.
sara-finance: will approve final invoice adjustments post-backfill.
julia_eng: quick note: will also add new unit tests covering multiple promos with overlapping windows and edge-case expiries.
kevin-billing: post-dry-run summary: 3 affected orgs, delta totals small (<$450). proceeding with controlled backfill after approvals.
eli-support: customer thanked us and asked for ETA — i gave 48h. they acknowledged. :thumbsup:
matt: nice catch. please add a postmortem once complete and include monitoring for `promo_consumption_mismatch` metric.
eli-support: will file postmortem and ping channel when done. thanks all.
